name: Firing Schedule
summary: Controlled firing-program visualization with one real-time planned model, required ramp chart and canonical Data Table, optional observed series, and no kiln-control behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Conditional named section or generic root emitted only for one valid planned program; the legacy firing-info root class is pre-v1 migration-only.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional wrapper for a non-empty contextual title.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading whose native rank is selected by the target.

anatomy.name: summary
anatomy.description: Visible starting-temperature, planned-duration and observed-lifecycle summary derived from the active normalized data.

anatomy.name: chart
anatomy.description: Required informative temperature-over-real-time figure derived from the same planned program used by the table.

anatomy.name: chartScroll
anatomy.description: Named keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll owner preserving legible axes at narrow widths.

anatomy.name: plot
anatomy.description: Informative SVG with localized accessible name and concise visible-series summary; raw samples never become focusable chart points.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: Visible native list identifying every displayed series through text and line treatment in addition to color.

anatomy.name: table
anatomy.description: Required canonical Data Table scroll owner containing one row per planned segment.

anatomy.name: dataTable
anatomy.description: Canonical native table with planned program columns and optional correlated actual-summary columns.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One chart-and-table presentation; planned, actual and both are controlled data views rather than independent visual variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic scroll containment with no public viewport breakpoint or chart dimensions.

states.name: planned
states.description: Shows the required derived planned curve and planned segment columns.

states.name: actual
states.description: Shows the controlled observed curve while the required table continues to identify each planned segment and may add correlated observed summaries.

states.name: both
states.description: Compares planned and observed curves with distinct labels and line treatments.

states.name: collecting
states.description: Truthfully labels a partial target-controlled observed series without announcing every sample.

states.name: complete
states.description: Labels the supplied observed series as complete.

behavior.name: singlePlannedSource
behavior.description: Neutral source validates one starting Celsius temperature and ordered stable segment records, then derives accumulated real time, planned chart points and table durations from that one program.

behavior.name: fullRateEstimate
behavior.description: A full-rate segment requires a positive target-reviewed estimated ramp duration and is visibly labelled estimated; otherwise the complete schedule is invalid and omitted.

behavior.name: controlledView
behavior.description: The target controls the visible series. Both is the inferred default when valid observed data exists, otherwise planned; actual is unavailable without observed samples.

behavior.name: normalizedUnitConversion
behavior.description: One normalized Celsius/seconds source drives every table, axis, legend and summary value. Fahrenheit display converts from that source and never consumes a duplicate dataset.

behavior.name: controlledObservedSeries
behavior.description: Targets replace timestamped observed samples at a bounded cadence. Neutral source never connects to a controller or sensor and never announces each sample.

behavior.name: accessibleVisualization
behavior.description: The informative SVG has a complete localized name and summary, the legend distinguishes series beyond color, and the canonical Data Table is the primary detailed representation. Raw samples add no sequential focus stops.

behavior.name: canonicalDataTable
behavior.description: One canonical Data Table row maps to each planned segment. Actual duration, reached temperature and deviation are optional summaries correlated by stable segmentId; raw samples never become table rows.

behavior.name: informativeSafetyBoundary
behavior.description: R6 visualizes target-reviewed information only. It never programs, starts, controls, validates or certifies a kiln, material, firing schedule or safety procedure.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional visible contextual heading; a non-empty value selects named native-section semantics while heading rank remains target-owned.

properties.name: startingTemperatureCelsius
properties.description: Finite normalized program start in degrees Celsius; display conversion never mutates this source value.

properties.name: segments
properties.description: Required non-empty ordered records with stable segmentId, positive rate or full-rate estimate, target Celsius temperature and non-negative hold seconds.

properties.name: actualSamples
properties.description: Optional strictly increasing elapsed-second/Celsius observations used only to draw the controlled actual curve; samples are not focusable and do not become table rows.

properties.name: actualSummaries
properties.description: Optional target-reviewed duration, reached-temperature and deviation records correlated to planned rows by stable segmentId.

properties.name: view
properties.unsetBehavior: Defaults to both when valid actual samples exist and otherwise planned; actual falls back to planned when no observed series is available.
properties.description: Controlled visible-series projection without duplicating the normalized source data.

properties.name: displayUnit
properties.description: Formats table, axes, legend and summaries from normalized Celsius values without a duplicate target dataset.

properties.name: actualStatus
properties.description: Truthful lifecycle label for a supplied observed series; ignored when no valid actual samples exist.

accessibility: Keep the required chart and canonical Data Table synchronized to the same validated planned program and active display unit.
Give the informative SVG a localized accessible name and concise summary of visible series, time, range, lifecycle and relevant deviation; retain a visible figcaption.
Use native table, caption, header scope and one row per planned segment; keep raw observed samples out of the table and sequential keyboard focus.
Distinguish planned and actual series with explicit legend text and dashed versus solid line treatment in addition to color.
Keep chart and table horizontal scroll owners named, keyboard-focusable and visibly focused without causing document overflow.
Do not announce every observed sample or add chart-point tooltips containing otherwise unavailable information.
Do not imply that the component programs, starts, controls, validates or certifies a kiln, firing schedule, material or safety procedure.

web.notes: Canonical CSS, Data Table composition and framework-independent components/js/firing-schedule.js model support one real-time planned source plus controlled observed data; targets render localized markup.

shopify.notes: Requires approved normalized schedule/observation records, validation, provenance, safety/editor rules and a first consumer before Liquid/schema.
